messages:
Alex R.: heading out in 10, leaving primary -> Maria G. as primary for next 8h, Kevin M. secondary. quick pass: incident queue low but watch for elevated latency on inference-hosts EU-WEST.
Maria G.: noted. Kevin, you see any gaps on AWS/Grafana access for the weekend?
Kevin M.: I don't have Grafana write on the /infra/inference dashboard (grafana.redwood.com/d/inf/serving-overview). can still view. if we need to annotate during incident, need edit or at least create snapshots.
Sanjay K.: I can create snapshots but won't be on-call overnight. Maria, can you request temp edit role for Kevin?
Maria G.: tagging ops-bot to request JIT role for Kevin and add him to PagerDuty escalation for the shift.
ops-bot: @Maria G. opened access request #AR-4567: Grant grafana:Editor and aws:AssumeRole (role/OncallJIT) to Kevin M. for 8 hours. Requires approval by Lisa T.
Lisa T.: approving AR-4567 now. Approve logs will be posted.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Kevin M. added to policy "oncall-inference-primary-secondary" for window 2026-03-15T22:00Z -> 2026-03-16T06:00Z.
Alex R.: one more: PagerDuty routing - if Maria doesn't ack within 5m escalate to Kevin, then to SRE rotation. check that PD schedule link is current: https://pd.redwood.com/schedules/inference
Maria G.: checked schedule, it's fine. Kevin, here's the runbook snippet for customer-impact triage (short form):
```
1) Confirm incident on PD and /incidents channel
2) Determine customer impact (API error rate vs latency vs timeouts)
3) If >= 5% QPS error or > 200ms P99 add SEV-2 and page sales/support
4) Follow mitigation tree: throttle-batch -> route-to-small-model -> scale-up-pool
5) Annotate Grafana and post in thread with pd incident id
```
Kevin M.: got it. do we have permission to scale Dedicated pools from the console or should I open an infra ticket?
Sanjay K.: console scaling for Dedicated requires aws role/assume and terraform run token. with OncallJIT you get the assume-role that allows api calls to autoscaler. include this as part of AR-4567.
Maria G.: AR updated to include TF token scoping. ops-bot, add a note to the request about terraform token scope.
ops-bot: AR-4567 updated: added terraform:apply-token scope (duration 1h).
Lisa T.: Kevin, after you accept JIT, verify access with this quick check:
```
# assume role and list inference clusters
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallJIT --role-session-name oncall-check
export AWS_TEMP_ACCESS_KEY=... # from creds
aws redwood-infra list-clusters --region eu-west-1
```
Expect to see clusters: serving-primary, serving-canary.
Kevin M.: will test before Alex signs out.
Alex R.: customer-impact note: Support flagged a 4% increase in timeouts for one customer in EU at 21:40Z. Not yet SEV but trending. Maria/Kevin please prioritize triage for that customer if they escalate.
Maria G.: opening a short investigation thread in #incidents and attaching logs. PD incident stub: INC-20260315-98.
pd-bot: Incident INC-20260315-98 created (title: "EU inference timeouts - trending") assigned to Maria G.
Maria G.: quick checklist for handoff: 1) PD routing ok, 2) Grafana snapshot created, 3) AWS JIT in progress, 4) runbook pinned in thread, 5) secondary informed. all done except JIT active.
Kevin M.: JIT active, assume-role test passed, can list clusters and run scaling dry-run. Grafana edit granted (can annotate).
Alex R.: perfect. leaving now. Maria primary, Kevin secondary. if anything that looks like customer impact >1k requests affected escalate immediately to SRE and exec-oncall.
Lisa T.: approved AR-4567 closure note: JIT privileges auto-revoke in 8h, terraform token auto-revoke in 1h. Audit link: https://audit.redwood.com/AR-4567
Sanjay K.: leaving a reminder: if you need to attach AWS support case, use support role: role/SupportJIT (different from OncallJIT) and open case with tag "inference-prod".
Maria G.: thanks all, will monitor. tagging @support and @sales on the customer thread if it escalates. :thumbsup:
Kevin M.: will keep watch on PD and Grafana alerts, will post any mitigation actions here.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Oncall handoff checklist review at +30m in this thread.
Alex R.: thanks team!
Maria G.: bye alex, enjoy the weekend :wave:
